caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, circular object composed primarily of cut tin and labeled as a "candle holder" with an exact size of 13 inches. The central element is a large, intricately patterned circle featuring radiating lines, scalloped edges, and concentric decorative motifs that appear to mimic the texture of pressed or embossed metal. Surrounding this central circle are six stylized bird-like figures, equally spaced and oriented radially outward, each with zigzag and dotted patterns on their bodies, and pointed beaks and tails. At the bottom, aligned with one of the bird figures, is a cylindrical candle holder segment, depicted in perspective with a visible base and socket. At the top, directly opposite the candle holder, is a fan-shaped extension with vertical line details and a single hole near its rounded end. The artwork is rendered in black and gray tones with fine linework, shading, and hatching to indicate texture and depth. Handwritten text on the lower left corner reads "CUT-TIN. CANDLE HOLDER. EXACT SIZE 13". The artist's signature and date, "B. Boyer. 36," appear just beneath the lower right bird figure. The composition is placed on an off-white background with no additional embellishments.
title: Cut Tin Candleholder
